normative_basis: DM 17-01-2018 NTC; DM 09-03-2023 n.52 amendments; Circolare 21-01-2019 n.7 C.S.LL.PP.
required_current_evidence_or_decision: Use the current NTC framework for present-state foundation/geotechnical verification while preserving historical assumptions separately.
model_use_rule: Do not replace current verification parameters with historical allowable-stress soil values.
note: Official 2026 MIT/CSLP material continues to reference the NTC issued with DM 17-01-2018; 2023 amendments are part of the current framework.

required_current_evidence_or_decision: Retain as historical geotechnical description and search for original geotechnical report/borings if they exist.
model_use_rule: Historical lithologic wording is evidence for the original model, not a complete present-day geotechnical model.
note: No modern stratigraphic or laboratory/in-situ parameter set is yet registered.

required_current_evidence_or_decision: Preserve both values exactly as historical calculation assumptions; determine their original modeling semantics before reproducing the historical calculation.
model_use_rule: Never map 1.6 kg/cm2 directly to a current design resistance or epsilon=1 to a modern stiffness parameter without an explicit conversion basis.
note: Historical admissible-pressure formulation and current limit-state geotechnical verification are distinct.

required_current_evidence_or_decision: Establish a site-specific ground model over the foundation influence volume: stratigraphic units, interfaces, variability and any relevant fill/altered surface layers.
model_use_rule: Use only evidence from existing reports, direct observations and an investigation program appropriate to the building/site.
note: No fixed number of boreholes/tests is imposed here; investigation scope must be justified from building size, geology, site variability and available prior evidence.

required_current_evidence_or_decision: Determine groundwater presence/level and relevant seasonal or local hydrogeological conditions where they can affect foundation behavior or soil parameters.
model_use_rule: Keep groundwater effects inactive in the numerical model until evidence establishes whether they are relevant.
note: Against-ground/semi-basement configuration makes explicit hydrogeological screening necessary.

normative_basis: NTC geotechnical model and foundation verification requirements
required_current_evidence_or_decision: Obtain representative strength parameters for the identified geotechnical units at stress levels relevant to the existing shallow foundations.
model_use_rule: Parameter selection must be traceable to tests/correlations and adopted characteristic/design values; no direct use of historical allowable pressure as a substitute.
note: Required parameter set depends on the chosen constitutive and verification model.

normative_basis: NTC geotechnical model and serviceability requirements
required_current_evidence_or_decision: Obtain deformation/stiffness information adequate to assess existing-foundation settlements and soil-structure interaction at the required analysis level.
model_use_rule: Do not invent Winkler modulus or elastic modulus from epsilon=1; if springs are used, derive them from a documented geotechnical model and foundation geometry.
note: Solver spring values are downstream products, not primary geotechnical evidence.

required_current_evidence_or_decision: Classify the seismic ground conditions required by the adopted analysis and assess any relevant site/geotechnical seismic phenomena using current evidence.
model_use_rule: Historical static seismic analysis does not close current seismic geotechnical characterization.
note: Exact inputs depend on the final assessment method and available site data.

current_project_evidence: No settlement damage reported in project record; direct foundation exposure/condition dataset not yet registered
required_current_evidence_or_decision: Document accessible foundation condition, cracking/deformation/settlement indicators and any exposure evidence; relate observations to the geotechnical model.
model_use_rule: Absence of observed settlement is useful current evidence but cannot alone identify soil parameters or resistance.
note: Keep structural deterioration and soil/foundation performance evidence distinct but cross-linked.

normative_basis: NTC current geotechnical characterization;existing-building knowledge needs
required_current_evidence_or_decision: Define the minimum justified investigation campaign after inventorying all existing geotechnical documents and direct site evidence; choose in-situ/laboratory methods to close the specific parameter gaps above.
model_use_rule: Do not prescribe a generic fixed campaign before reviewing existing evidence and accessibility constraints.
note: The program is evidence-gap driven and may be reduced if adequate original/current geotechnical documentation is recovered.
